jobs.title: BOW DEFENSE PLOT
jobs.design: Replace title with HAVENLINE / BOW DEFENSE PLOT. Replace every $300 with $175, keeping exact price-line world orientation and spacing. Central symbol: copy the source crop's single stylized WHITE BOW AND NOCKED ARROW, a bent/curved bow limb with a thin taut string and one straight arrow pointing toward the physical LEFT atFRONT0. Preserve the source compact curved bow silhouette and arrowhead/fletching; no shield, crossed swords, extra arrows or plus sign. This is one 2D painted stencil, not a real bow lying on the plot. The arrow points screenLEFT at0, upperLEFT at45, UP at90, upperRIGHT at135, RIGHT at180, lowerRIGHT at225, DOWN at270, lowerLEFT at315. The curved bow and string rotate together with the arrow in the same ground plane and remain centered, all eight. White icon style should be as simple/clean as source, no texture, no shadow volume. Outside labels remain upright. Observed symbol is called bow defense for this visual concept; exact gameplay behavior and balance are not asserted.

At135 and225 retain their correct reversed back-facing orientations from FIRST, never redraw readable-to-camera text or mirror individual characters. Keep exactly four corner brackets. The price is a REFERENCE DISPLAY EXAMPLE, not implemented Havenline economy.
